Container.Name: ao3-archive
Container.Overview: Search, read and download the EPUBs inside the AO3 "things" archive (105 zip files, about 746 GiB) without extracting them. On first start it indexes every zip into one SQLite file in the Index folder (about 30 GB for 20 million works; several hours, resumable). Search by title, author, fandom or tag, read chapters in the browser, and download the original .epub.[br][br]Data folder: the folder your torrent client saved the zips into. It is mounted read-only.[br]Index folder: where ao3.db is written. Put it on a share with room for about 35 GB.[br][br]Keep this on your LAN. It has no login.
Container.Requires: The "things" torrent downloaded to a share.

Config.Name: Data folder (torrent zips)
Config.Description: Folder holding queue01.zip ... queue94.zip and the other zips from the torrent. Read-only.

Config.Name: Index folder
Config.Description: Where the search index ao3.db is stored (about 30 GB for 20M works, about 35 GB with summary search). Use a disk share instead of appdata if your cache pool is small.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the index files. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the index files. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for the index files.

Config.Name: Index workers
Config.Description: How many CPU threads parse EPUBs while indexing. 0 uses all of them. Lower it to keep the server responsive.

Config.Name: Searchable summaries
Config.Description: true makes summaries searchable (index about 20% larger). Only applies when the index is first created.

Config.Name: Index on start
Config.Description: Index new or unfinished zips in the background whenever the container starts.
